heading: School Board Approves $99.7 Million Tax Levy
summary: The board approved a total property tax levy of $99,688,186. Members discussed how growth in property values affected the district's mill rate. They also compared the figures with earlier projections.

heading: Utilities Commission Backs Power Supply Contract Amendment
summary: The commission voted to recommend Common Council approval of an amendment to the long-term power supply contract. The discussion covered future capacity needs and how WPPI plans to secure power. The recommendation sends the amendment to the council for consideration.

heading: Wisconsin Joins Dollar General Pricing Lawsuit
summary: Wisconsin DOJ joined the Federal Trade Commission and 19 other states in suing Dollar General. The complaint alleges customers were repeatedly charged more at the register than prices advertised in stores. The coalition is challenging what it describes as a long-running practice.
